Say goodbye to costly redesigns and manual updates to your store signage. From schedules and seasonal promotions to important notices, Samsung Color E-Paper is a smarter alternative to traditional paper posters for businesses that need to update content frequently and across multiple locations. 

Upgrade to a versatile, easy-to-manage signage solution that consumes zero watts of power when displaying static images and can help lower operating costs over time. Available in 32-inch, 20-inch and 13-inch sizes, Samsung Color E-Paper aligns with familiar paper formats for an easier transition from print to digital.

Discover more at http://smsng.co/yt_B2Bsolutions
